steps.text: Optional, never applied by Play: puts the DXVK-MacOS 3.1 Direct3D 9 (the engine's d9vk-modern directory) beside RRRE64.exe with a per-program override, so this game alone runs on it while every other game keeps the default layer. It rendered the game, practice and races with AI, for one reporter on an M3 whose sessions froze with VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST on the default layer (highball-db#60); when the withdrawn r4 engine put the same layer on every launch's path, another reporter got RaceRoom in grayscale and a third had Five Nights at Freddy's freeze, so it is offered under Advanced rather than applied. On the maintainer's M1 Pro the same DLL runs Five Nights at Freddy's without a freeze (2026-09-18). RaceRoom itself is not installed here (74 GB).

knownIssues.symptom: Pre-race screen freezes after the track loads, VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST in the Direct3D 9 log (default layer)
knownIssues.cause: reported: the DXVK-Kegworks 1.10.4 Direct3D 9 loses the Metal device on this game
knownIssues.fix: apply this optional fix under Advanced on the game's page; if the picture turns grayscale, remove the copied d3d9.dll next to RRRE64.exe and the override, both reported outcomes exist

knownIssues.symptom: Applying this fix changes nothing on a DXVK launch
knownIssues.cause: measured 2026-09-20 on Half-Life 2 with +loaddll: on a DXVK launch the engine's own Direct3D 9 overlay is found before the copy beside the game's executable (the launch's WINEDLLOVERRIDES outranks the per-program registry entry), so the newer layer never loads; it loads on a wined3d launch
knownIssues.fix: none shipped yet; a per-program layer choice is planned (Highball plan item 14). Setting this game's mode to Wine's own Direct3D makes the copy the Direct3D 9 in use, untested on RaceRoom
